# file — the next build overwrites anything written here.

# THIS IS NOT THE WHOLE POLICY. Cloudflare prepends a managed block, so what
# wifiodds.com serves is roughly four times this file. To change the
# AI-crawler posture use the Cloudflare dashboard; nothing here can override
# it. `bash build/edge-drift.sh` compares the two.
#
# The posture: CITABLE, NOT TRAINABLE. Quote freely, including the numbers,
# provided the credits travel with them (unitedstarlinktracker.com /
# alaskastarlinktracker.com by @martinamps). Training crawlers are blocked
# upstream and are deliberately NOT contradicted here.
#
# Machine-readable summary: /llms.txt   Full United dataset: /united/data.json

# uncitable while trying to stay untrainable.
